description.value:
Cast 1 minute

Requirement The target is unwilling and restrained, unconscious, or otherwise unable to resist you.

Range touch

You are not hurting them. You are showing them the inside of their own arm and asking a question about it.

The target attempts a Will save against your class DC. On a failure it takes a −2 circumstance penalty to saves against your Coerce and Request attempts for 1 hour, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks to Treat Wounds on it for the same hour.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. Both the Will-save penalty on a restrained target's future Coerce/Request saves and the Medicine bonus for the caster affect a different creature's future rolls/checks-against-it.
